usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the APT repository configuration on a specific node of a PVE remote — useful for verifying that enterprise/community repos are correctly configured and no-subscription repos are present before running updates. The caller must hold Resource.Audit privilege on the remote's node system path; the target node must be online and reachable by PDM. Note that the spec declares returns as null, so consumers should treat any meaningful payload as implementation-defined.

examples.summary: List APT repositories on node 'pve01' of the 'hetzner-pve' remote

tips: The 'node' path param accepts 'localhost' as a special value when PDM itself is a PVE node.
Cross-reference results with update-related endpoints to confirm repo hygiene before scheduling apt upgrades.
No query parameters are accepted; all inputs are path-only.
